records.title: Protection Mechanism Failure
records.summary: Missing browser security controls can map to a broad protection mechanism weakness category for triage.
records.remediation_summary: Add the missing defense-in-depth control where appropriate for the application context.
safe_next_steps: Validate expected browser security controls from supplied metadata and owner documentation.

records.title: Improper Restriction of Rendered UI Layers or Frames
records.summary: Missing frame restrictions should be reviewed when administrative, login, or account surfaces are present.
records.remediation_summary: Set frame restrictions with Content-Security-Policy frame-ancestors or an equivalent policy for legacy clients.
safe_next_steps: Confirm intended framing behavior before recommending enforcement changes.
